title: deferred-work.md records a phantom staleness: label-invariants already ticks consent before empty-submit
evidence:
The entry claims: "Remaining pre-existing staleness (unowned): apply-form-label-invariants' empty-submit step clicks a consent-disabled submit button (needs force_submit or consent tick)." But .claude/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/landing/apply-form-label-invariants.yaml (read at the reviewed sha) contains, immediately before the submit click: "  - action: javascript
    description: "Check consent checkbox (fires change event to enable submit via form.js)"
    code: |
      const consent = document.querySelector('[data-testid="gdpr-consent-checkbox"]');
      ...
      consent.click();" followed by "  - action: click
    selector: '[data-testid="submit-application"]'
    description: "Submit form with required fields empty"". form.js:17-37 confirms ticking removes data-consent-blocked and enables the button, and git log -S 'consent checkbox did not toggle' shows the tick step has been present since the scenario's introduction (62bc936).
detail: The scenario does exactly what the entry says it needs: consent is ticked (enabling submit) right before the empty-submit click. The recorded 'staleness' does not exist at this sha; a future maintainer could chase or 'fix' a non-issue.
recommended_fix: Strike or correct the 'Remaining pre-existing staleness' clause in the deferred-work.md:552 entry; if a real failure was reproduced, record the actual failing step instead.
